endpoint: cr.selcloud.ru documented Selectel data origin, /v2 separate from management /api; unsupported locations unavailable unless explicit override; exact refs pinned
auth: explicit project-bound Basic snapshot; compiled preflight before any body transmission, Basic/Bearer negotiation within same budget; HTTPS same-origin realm only; nonempty advertised service and compiled exact repository/action scope; realm query permits only overwritten service/scope, never offline token/auth override. Tokens protected, redirects never followed. Auth endpoint404 is endpoint_unavailable, not content absence

request.mapping: canonical OCI namespace, tag/digest syntax and parent chain checked; request refs are caller-selected addresses, not ownership/creation proof. Typed Accept and content media types OCI image/index, Docker v2 image/list; no arbitrary headers/auth overrides; manifest bytes preserved without transformation OCI subject descriptor is validated only for OCI image/index; unsupported subject algorithm is capability_unavailable before I/O. Payload bytes remain unchanged. Explicit local FallbackTag/PrepareTagIndex helpers perform no HTTP/credential lookup and emit source-only new descriptor fields, verify content digest/subject and same-repository snapshot, copy annotations and artifactType/config fallback, bound bytes/count and suppress duplicates or remove exact digest entries.
request.body: Protected JSON, unchanged wire bytes, bounded by StructuredLimit; typed OCI/Docker v2 media type and optional declared mediaType consistency; digest-address input verified before I/O. Single remote manifest PUT only, no referrers fallback mutations.

response.mapping: 201 Accepted before decode; exact requested address retained; verified source/computed digest and protected same-origin same-repository Location; unrelated malformed headers retain trusted address/metadata Typed RequestedSubject/AcknowledgedSubject retain OCI-Subject correspondence. Absent acknowledgement sets NeedsTagFallback only on accepted response; malformed/mismatched acknowledgement retains Accepted receipt/error, never automatic lookup/fallback/replay. Pure prepared index includes informational BaseDigest, not a precondition or atomicity proof.

errors.shared: normal HTTP status mapping and bounded safe-read retry; first errors[0].code from pinned OCI allowlist retained exactly; provider message/detail discarded. Diagnostic read/decode failure does not suppress401/403/503 status semantics; cancellation closes optional diagnostic body once under whole call/transfer budget; documented rejection status is retained before diagnostics
errors.mutation: only source rejected statuses conclusive; transport/5xx unknown,no replay; malformed201/202 remains Accepted

retry: bounded safe reads; no mutation replay, rollback or source fallback
recovery: Root Resource/Resume validate exact scope, generation, parents, endpoint and receipt operation/revision/effect. Known no-ref/multi-ref receipts Recover conclusive with no I/O; unknown content-address receipts observe exact HEAD only, never mutation replay/adoption/creation proof. Start/Append/Cancel receipt alone lacks protected Location/query: unknown session Status/Recover unavailable; Finalize retains caller-requested blob digest address before I/O and observes only exact HEAD without creation proof; caller-held UploadSession supports explicit exact Status offset observation, not mutation outcome proof. No wait goals inferred.
compatibility: same-origin realm/query restrictions not a claim about undocumented Selectel topology; optional deletion/server availability untested; inventory incomplete

conditional_http.source: RFC9110 sections8.8.3/13.1.1/13.1.2/13.2; OCI1.1.1 referrers tag workflow conditional HTTP MAY
conditional_http.request: Explicit typed wildcard or nonempty entity-tag list; protected tags, bounded total header bytes; If-Match strong comparison, If-None-Match weak comparison; both permitted with RFC precedence. No digest-derived ETag, automatic precondition, retry or fallback.
conditional_http.response: Optional GET/HEAD ETag is opaque protected metadata, never digest or ownership proof. HTTP412 is conclusive Rejected. Successful201 only Accepted, not proof the server enforced a precondition.
conditional_http.availability: Conditional HTTP support and concurrency atomicity on Selectel remain unverified; caller explicitly selects this protocol variant.

confirmed_protocol_not_in_this_subset: Extended/multiple Link syntax; additional image formats/digest algorithms
selectel_source_unknown: actual Bearer realm/service topology and custom query requirements
availability of optional tag/blob deletion, referrers, mount/monolithic POST, native cancellation
